A generation prompt must end at a USER/TOOL boundary (the turn the assistant answers).

cases.input: A READ-ONLY SQLITE INSTRUMENT OPENED `immutable=1` MISSES ROWS STILL IN THE `-wal` FILE ON A LIVE WAL DATABASE — `file:…?immutable=1` reads ONLY the main database file and never consults the `-wal`, so on a database the live service runs in WAL mode any row not yet checkpointed out of the WAL is INVISIBLE to the reader; a durably-committed fresh row can stay invisible for minutes (until an auto-checkpoint at ~1000 WAL pages). An evidence collector that binds a just-made request to its recorded row then reads `0 rows` and fails — intermittently, depending on WAL-checkpoint timing and unrelated traffic. Rule: read a LIVE WAL database `mode=ro` (read-only AND WAL-aware), never `immutable=1`; reserve `immutable=1` for a quiescent/copied DB no process is writing.
